behavior: Attach a per-request Node aborted listener and compose its AbortController signal with the existing Effect signal before constructing the final Request.
The Web Request source path continues to compose its existing native signal.
Never turn Node end or close into cancellation; only aborted or an already aborted source forwards abort.
Attach a passive error guard before the aborted listener so reader cancellation cannot expose a queued Node error.
Actual close removes all own aborted/error/close listeners. Cleanup is idempotent and clears an outstanding Immediate.
If Node closed is alreadytrue, schedule one unref Immediate for cleanup; closed is set before queued error/close, so synchronous cleanup is unsafe.

A finally enclosing declared-length validation, stream construction and handling detaches the aborted listener on every return/throw, while the passive error/close guard survives only until actual close or the already-closed fallback.
